title: Integer 0 expands as empty in {?x} and {;x}
evidence: ScalarVariableValue includes int; RFC 6570 expands the string form of the value, '0' is non-empty. Code uses truthiness (`if value:`) in _query_expansion/_semi_path_expansion, so 0 is treated as empty; other operators give '0'.

title: partial() leaves variable unexpanded when value is empty string
property: partial with all variables supplied equals expand
evidence: partial docs: only missing params stay in the template; x was given. template._expand uses `expanded.get(...) or var`, conflating empty expansion with absent.

title: Prefix modifier crashes on integer values
property: {a:N} on an int value truncates its string form without raising
evidence: VariableValue type allows int; RFC 6570 prefix applies to the string form; value[:prefix] is applied without str() conversion in variable.py.
